name: JPYdf
oneLiner: JPYdf is a yen-targeted Liquity v2 fork on Ethereum, borrowed against wstETH or USDC, with no yen redemption claim and no admitted runtime price yet.
collateral: User-deposited wstETH and USDC in two isolated Liquity v2 branches, held through 18-decimal dToken wrappers that the protocol treats as 1:1 claims on the underlying. Minimum collateral ratios are 123.18% for wstETH and 111.58% for USDC, with critical ratios of 141.67% and 124.50%. At Ethereum block 26196851 (October 15 2026), the branches held 586,394 USDC and 79.39 wstETH, putting USDC at about 71% of collateral value at the oracle's last good prices. An upgradeable vault and strategy layer may lend USDC through Aave V3 or Morpho V2; no principal was deployed at that block. DeltaForesight's corporate financing is not token collateral.
pegMechanism: Only registered BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts can mint JPYdf, which users borrow against overcollateralized troves at user-set interest rates. Undercollateralized troves are liquidated against the branch Stability Pool or redistributed to other troves in the branch. Any holder can redeem JPYdf for dToken collateral valued at ¥1 per JPYdf, less a fee of at least 0.5% plus a base rate that decays with a six-hour half-life. Chainlink JPY/USD, stETH/USD, ETH/USD, stETH/ETH and USDC/USD feeds price collateral. The yen is a value target only: JPYdf carries no yen monetary claim, no yen redemption right and no face-value buyback commitment.
launchPhaseDetail: JPY DeFi launched on Ethereum mainnet on October 15 2026, so JPYdf is live. Pharos tracks it pre-launch only because no runtime price source admits it: on launch day DefiLlama and CoinGecko listed neither the token nor the protocol, and the DefiLlama contract-price endpoint returned no quote. The token is 0xb122f4a154f84708407213d6a715181180012f45 (18 decimals, Ethereum only, no registered bridge minter). At block 26196851 (08:54 UTC on October 15), supply was 91,738,933 JPYdf, about $581,000 at that day's yen rate, with 69.4 million borrowed against USDC and 22.3 million against wstETH. Trading was confined to one Uniswap v4 JPYdf/USDC pool created that morning with about $552,000 of liquidity. The token and the Liquity v2 core are non-upgradeable and the token owner is renounced. The dToken vault and strategy layer is upgradeable and pausable, and governance can recognize collateral losses, replace oracle sources after a 12-hour timelock and resume paused branches without delay. The governance, operator and guardian Safes are each 2-of-3 with the same three signers, although the documentation describes a higher quorum for loss recognition. The deployed JPY/USD staleness threshold is 30 hours, while the documentation describes 72 hours. Chain Defenders and Guardian reviewed the JPYdf-specific code; the bug bounty and confidential disclosure channel were not active at launch. JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC operates the app, which excludes Japanese residents, and does not disclose its domicile.

featuredContent.title: JPY DeFi launches on Ethereum mainnet
featuredContent.description: DeltaForesight reports the October 15 launch with wstETH and USDC branches, an app run by JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC that excludes Japanese residents, and no yen redemption right.

featuredContent.title: DeltaForesight announces development of JPYdf before mainnet
featuredContent.description: The developer describes cryptoasset and stablecoin collateral, rule-based overcollateralized issuance and liquidation, while disclaiming yen redemption rights.

featuredContent.title: DeltaForesight plans Fusion vaults after JPY DeFi mainnet
featuredContent.description: IPOR Labs is to provide vault infrastructure and technical support; chains, strategies and offering terms remain undecided.

milestones.title: Chain Defenders completes two JPYdf security reviews
milestones.description: The first review lists 1 High, 3 Medium and 7 Low findings among 21, with 10 fixed and 11 acknowledged; a follow-up enhancement review lists 2 Medium and 3 Low, with four fixed. The reports themselves were not independently reviewed by Pharos.

milestones.title: DeltaForesight announces JPYdf development before mainnet
milestones.description: The developer publishes the overcollateralized borrowing design and announces corporate J-KISS financing. Launch timing and user terms remain unannounced; the financing is not protocol backing.

milestones.title: DeltaForesight plans related vaults using Fusion by IPOR
milestones.description: Related ERC-4626 vaults are planned after JPY DeFi mainnet, subject to development, security audits and legal review. IPOR Labs provides infrastructure and technical support; token deployments and offering terms are not announced.

milestones.title: Guardian issues updated review of JPYdf-specific changes
milestones.description: The protocol reports no Critical, High or Medium findings in the reviewed scope, with 17 resolved and four acknowledged. A Guardian-hosted contest and post-launch bug bounty were still in preparation.

milestones.title: JPY DeFi launches on Ethereum mainnet
milestones.description: Public launch with wstETH and USDC branches. Supply reached 91.7 million JPYdf by 08:54 UTC, with no DefiLlama or CoinGecko listing.

milestones.title: DefiLlama begins tracking JPYdf supply without a price
milestones.description: DefiLlama added JPYdf as stablecoin 448 on October 22 2026, reporting about 93.3 million JPYdf on Ethereum, matching on-chain total supply. DefiLlama carries no price for it and CoinGecko has no listing.
